init.title: HDL Buspro Options
init.description: Choose an action to manage your HDL Buspro setup:

menu_options.add_bridge: Control a Non-HDL Device from an HDL Panel
menu_options.import_file: Import / Update from File (Excel, CSV, JSON)

add_device.title: Add Device or Sensor Manually
add_device.description: Enter the device details and hardware address (Subnet.Device.Channel):

data.name: Device Name (e.g. Ceiling Light, Room Temp)

add_scene.title: Add Scene or Sequence Button
add_scene.description: Scenes and sequences are stored in an HDL module. Enter the module address and the area and scene/sequence number from HDL Buspro Setup Tool.

add_color_light.title: Add Tunable-White / RGB Light
add_color_light.description: Combine the dimmer or LED-driver channels of one light. List the channels in order: warm, cool for tunable white; red, green, blue (and white) for RGB / RGBW.

add_bridge.title: Control a Non-HDL Device from an HDL Panel
add_bridge.description: Home Assistant will answer on the HDL bus as a virtual device at the address below. In HDL Buspro Setup Tool, point a panel button at this address (universal switch or channel number) and it will control the chosen entity — for example a Tuya light. The panel's button LED follows the entity. Use an address no real module uses (device IDs 200-254 are usually free). Works only while Home Assistant is running.

remove_bridge.title: Remove Bridged Devices
remove_bridge.description: Tick the bridged devices to remove.

scan_bus.title: Scan the Bus for Modules
scan_bus.description: Home Assistant asks every module on the bus for its name and type. This takes a few seconds per output module. Modules you already configured are skipped.

scan_select.title: Modules Found
scan_select.description: Found {count} new modules. Tick the ones to add. Dimmer channels become dimmable lights; panels get button events and a temperature sensor; sensors get their temperature, light and motion entities.

import_file.title: Import / Update from File
import_file.description: Provide the path or paste content of an Excel (.xlsx), CSV (.csv), or JSON backup file:

data.gateway_ip_filter: Only accept messages from the gateway's IP address
data.online_check_interval: Check modules are online every N seconds (0 = off, minimum 30)
data.bus_monitor: Bus monitor: fire a buspro_telegram event for every message

add_raw_sensor.title: Add Raw Read Sensor (experimental)
add_raw_sensor.description: Polls an HDL read command and decodes bytes of the reply. The power-meter presets fill in the command, unit and type, but their reply layout is not documented anywhere public: turn on the bus monitor, capture a reply from your meter, and set the byte offset, length and scale to match. Codes are hexadecimal (e.g. D90A).
